about: Cordarone X (amiodarone), by brand name only, is supplied ten times from December 2025 to September 2026 to a 74-year-old man.
Aratac (amiodarone) is supplied four times from January to April 2026 to a 70-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history.

Norvasc (amlodipine), a blood pressure medicine whose name resembles amiodarone, and Noten (atenolol), a beta-blocker, are supplied throughout, and no amiodarone or dronedarone is supplied, so the criterion is not met.
